text:
emily_support: FYI customer says their free credits dropped to 0 after we issued a refund earlier today. dashboard shows 200 free credits, invoice/ledger shows 0. pasted their note below.
raj_customer: I used 50 credits this morning, then we issued a refund for a duplicate charge at 09:12. After that my available credits went to 0. Dashboard still shows 200 but api returns 0 available. Can you please check?
emily_support: Org ID: org_8f7a3d, account email: raj@acmecorp.com. I tried GET /v1/credits and response was `{
  "available_free_credits": 0,
  "meta": {"ledger_balance": -50} 
}`
kevin_billing: pinging billing team. @sam_engineer can you look at ledger entries? this smells like a backfill ordering issue after refund adjustment.
billing_bot: Refund applied: refund_2024_09_03 for invoice inv_9001 by kevin_billing at 2024-09-03T09:12:34Z. Ledger entry queued for async backfill.
sam_engineer: quick check: looks like the backfill job wrote the refund entry before the free-credit allocation re-run completed, so the recompute loop subtracted refunded tokens from the post-recompute balance. probable race. i see duplicate ledger rows for tx_refunded on org_8f7a3d: run:```sql
SELECT id, kind, amount, created_at FROM ledger_entries WHERE org_id='org_8f7a3d' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 6;
-- results: id: le_9012 kind:refund amount:-50 created_at:2024-09-03T09:12:34Z
-- id: le_9011 kind:free_credit_grant amount:200 created_at:2024-08-01T00:00:00Z
-- id: le_9013 kind:recompute_adjustment amount:-150 created_at:2024-09-03T09:12:35Z
```
emily_support: ok. what's the short remediation we can run for the customer? they want credits visible asap.
sam_engineer: short fix: run the ledger reapply for org with the idempotent recompute endpoint: `POST /internal/admin/orgs/org_8f7a3d/recompute-ledger` (auth required). This will re-apply grants and ensure ordering. I'm going to run it in staging first then prod. Will also patch the backfill to include a small lock so grant recompute finishes before refund write.
kevin_billing: scheduling now — running recompute, will post job id.
billing_bot: Job queued: recompute_job_5546 for org_8f7a3d (initiated by kevin_billing).
kevin_billing: recompute finished, job id recompute_job_5546, audit: audit_33211. After recompute API call, GET /v1/credits returns `{"available_free_credits": 200}` for raj. I also pushed a short-term fix to the backfill: add linear retry + lock on org ledger writes.
emily_support: reported back to customer: "We ran a ledger recompute and restored your free credits. You should see 200 available now. We're deploying a fix to prevent this in future."
raj_customer: confirmed, credits are back, thanks! :tada:
kevin_billing: follow-up: created ticket BILL-452 to add stronger ordering guarantees and an extra metric to alert if recompute writes happen within 1s of refund writes. Also adding reconciliation job that compares dashboard vs ledger daily for free_credit grants.
sam_engineer: will open a PR for the lock + test repro case. linking here once ready.
emily_support: closing thread for now, will reopen if customer sees any regression.
